title: Sphynx Cat Composer
description: A hairless sphynx cat with glasses sits at a wooden desk in an attic, drawing musical notes with a yellow pencil on a sketchbook. In the background, a demon plays saxophone, a small furry creature plays drums, and a purple furry monster plays guitar, all illuminated by a beam of light from a skylight.
prompt: A surreal scene in a dusty purple attic with a skylight casting a dramatic beam of light. A hairless sphynx cat wearing round glasses sits on a wooden desk drawing musical notes with a yellow pencil. In the background, a dark demon plays a golden saxophone, a small fluffy creature plays a drum kit, and a purple furry monster plays an acoustic guitar. Sheet music, coffee mug, and open case with art supplies are scattered around. Moody, whimsical, and slightly eerie atmosphere.
